channel.description: Recent content in Philosophy on Nikita Obraztsov

item.title: What Does It Mean to Be a Rational Person?
item.description: Based on an appearance on the Pascal's Wager podcast. On the nature of rationality, its limits, astrology, and why rationality is a tool rather than a sacred cow.

item.title: Benedict Spinoza: Heretic, Lens Grinder, and God as Substance
item.description: On the life and philosophy of Spinoza: excommunication from the synagogue, pantheism, the Ethics, and why Einstein invoked his name when asked about God.

item.title: Agnosticism: Between Belief and Unbelief
item.description: What agnosticism actually is, how it differs from atheism and scepticism, and why Bertrand Russell called himself an agnostic among colleagues but an atheist for public audiences.
